notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put all Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Ganax triggers five times.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating 30 Treasure tokens.
Activate thirteen Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Orthion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
You may also instead target any other creature using Orthion's ability.
